narration: Your boss already knows the max they'd ever pay you. It's called a salary band — and they're allowed to keep it hidden while you sit thousands below your ceiling.
visual: Worker silhouette at desk, boss figure behind them holding a document labeled SALARY BANDS with a redacted line. Question mark floats above the worker's head.

narration: Every job has a salary band — a floor, a midpoint, and a ceiling. That range can span forty to eighty percent from bottom to top. Most workers are sitting near the floor.
visual: Horizontal band/ruler graphic growing from left to right. Three markers appear: FLOOR at left, MIDPOINT in center, CEILING at right. A person marker appears near the floor end labeled YOU.

narration: Research shows sixty percent of workers are paid below their salary band midpoint. Your company already planned to pay more — they're waiting for you to ask. Wild, right?
visual: Ten by ten grid of 100 person icons. Sixty icons highlight red labeled BELOW MIDPOINT. Forty stay green labeled AT OR ABOVE. Counter shows 60%.

narration: Ten states now require employers to post salary ranges in job listings. Workers in those states earn an average of fourteen thousand dollars more per year. The rest are flying blind.
visual: Ten state abbreviation badges pop in one by one. Large dollar amount +$14K animates in below. Label: PAY-TRANSPARENT STATES.

narration: Asking for your band costs absolutely nothing. Workers who use band data in salary talks earn over five thousand five hundred more on average. Your boss expects the question — they're surprised when you don't ask.
visual: Worker figure with speech bubble asking WHAT'S THE SALARY BAND? HR figure on right. Counter animates from $0 to $5,500. Label: AVERAGE GAIN FROM ASKING.

narration: Before your next review, ask HR one question: what's the salary band for my role? It's legal, it's expected, and it might be the most profitable sentence you say all year.
visual: Blue quote box with the question WHAT'S THE SALARY BAND FOR MY ROLE? Checklist items animate in: Ask HR, Know your ceiling, Negotiate to midpoint. CTA: FOLLOW FOR MORE HIDDEN MONEY MOVES.
